title: Backfill/seed all 16 regulatoryNumberSequences counter keys
description:
One-off migration or idempotent startup check that reads the current maximum sequence value per pool (both number types) from existing accreditation/registration data / the production public register export, and seeds regulatoryNumberSequences.CurrentMax to at least that value for all 16 keys (R-ER, R-EX, R-NR, R-NX, R-SR, R-SX, R-WR, R-WX, A-ER, A-EX, A-NR, A-NX, A-SR, A-SX, A-WR, A-WX). Launch blocker per AC4 — missing this means the new endpoints reissue numbers that already exist. Must never lower an existing higher CurrentMax (idempotent re-run safe).

Depends on: RegulatoryNumberSequenceCounter model/collection task.

Acceptance Criteria:
- After backfill, CurrentMax for each of the 16 keys is >= the corresponding maximum found in the source dataset at backfill time
- Running the backfill a second time is a no-op that never resets/lowers an already-seeded CurrentMax

title: Full test suite: format, concurrency, idempotency, regenerate contrast, AC9
description:
Follow this repo's existing pattern (EprRegisterEnrolBackend.Test/AccreditationApplication/Endpoints/FakeAccreditationApplicationPersistence.cs) — add a FakeRegulatoryNumberSequenceStore or similar in-memory double so endpoint tests don't need a real Mongo instance.

Coverage across both endpoints: format-assembly correctness sampled across the 8 AgencyType x 8 Material combinations for both number types; counter independence across pools and between the registration/accreditation pools for the same AgencyType; concurrent generation (>=50 parallel Tasks against the atomic increment) never collides, once for registration and once for accreditation; idempotent re-call returns the same number for both endpoints; the two DIFFERENT regenerate mechanisms explicitly contrasted (registration draws a new sequence and DOES mutate CurrentMax; accreditation increments YY only and does NOT mutate CurrentMax); terminal-status and not-found paths return correct status codes with no counter mutation for both endpoints; AC9 ordering (accreditation 409s with no registration number, registration endpoint unaffected by accreditation state).

Depends on: both endpoint tasks.

Acceptance Criteria:
- A single test file/suite exercises both endpoints end-to-end against FakeRegulatoryNumberSequenceStore, with no dependency on a real Mongo instance
- The registration-regenerate-vs-accreditation-regenerate contrast is asserted explicitly in at least one test (so a future change collapsing the two mechanisms back together would fail CI)

title: POST accreditation-number endpoint (generate/idempotent/YY-increment regenerate)
description:
POST {organisationId}/{applicationId}/accreditation-number -> GenerateOrUpdateAccreditationNumber, sharing the same private helper as the registration endpoint with a different NumberType.

Behaviour: everything the registration endpoint has (404/409-terminal/400-no-counter-mutation/idempotent-return), PLUS AC9's extra precondition — 409 if the application has no registration number yet. RA-448: regenerate ("reapply for accreditation") does NOT draw a new sequence and does NOT touch regulatoryNumberSequences — it increments only the existing number's YY segment by 1 in place (e.g. 26 -> 27), leaving prefix/AgencyType/OrgID/Sequence/Material byte-identical, and still appends the pre-increment number to PreviousAccreditationNumbers (kept distinct from PreviousRegistrationNumbers). Auth = same CaseManagement scheme as the registration endpoint.

Depends on: generator service task, registration-number endpoint task (shared helper).

Acceptance Criteria:
- Calling the endpoint when the application has no registration number yet returns 409 without generating or mutating any counter
- Regenerate increments only the YY segment of the existing accreditation number and does not mutate regulatoryNumberSequences.CurrentMax for the accreditation pool
notes:
ARCHITECTURE FINDING: no existing field equivalent to RegistrationReference exists for accreditation - add a NEW field AccreditationReference to AccreditationApplicationModel (name matches the existing RegistrationReference convention; do not call it AccreditationNumber as the source doc guessed, for naming consistency). Also add PreviousAccreditationNumbers list (kept distinct from PreviousRegistrationNumbers).
Same FakeAccreditationApplicationPersistence.ShallowCopy update required as the registration task - add AccreditationReference and PreviousAccreditationNumbers there too (one shared fix, don't duplicate if the registration task already did it - check first).

title: POST registration-number endpoint (generate/idempotent/regenerate)
description:
POST {organisationId}/{applicationId}/registration-number -> GenerateOrUpdateRegistrationNumber, following the existing Minimal API conventions in AccreditationApplicationEndpoints.cs (shared private helper style, e.g. RejectIfTerminal / NextSiteId).

Behaviour: 404 if application missing; 409 if terminal/ineligible status (RejectIfTerminal-style guard); 400 on unknown material/agency/processing-type WITHOUT touching any counter; if a number already exists and no explicit regenerate flag, return it unchanged (idempotent, no counter mutation); if regenerating, draw a brand-new sequence via IRegulatoryNumberGenerator and append the old number to a PreviousRegistrationNumbers audit-trail list on the application document (old number never reused); persist via existing IAccreditationApplicationPersistence.UpdateAsync; auth = same CaseManagement scheme as existing case-management/{workItemId}/query and .../status routes.

Depends on: generator service task.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Idempotent re-call (no regenerate flag) on an application that already has a number returns the unchanged existing number and does not mutate the counter
- Regenerate draws a new sequence, persists it, and appends the prior number to PreviousRegistrationNumbers without reusing/reissuing it
notes:
ARCHITECTURE FINDING: reuse the EXISTING AccreditationApplicationModel.RegistrationReference field for this endpoint's output, do NOT add a new RegistrationNumber field. RegistrationReference is currently populated only once, at Seed time, from ReEx's registration.RegistrationNumber (HttpReExApiAdapter.cs:283) and pushed to case-management as registrationNumber (HttpCaseWorkingApiAdapter.cs:522) - no other code writes to it, so this endpoint becomes its only post-creation writer, no conflicting writer to worry about. AC5 "no number yet -> generate" naturally means RegistrationReference is null (e.g. org has no ReEx-sourced number); "already has one -> idempotent return" naturally covers both ReEx-seeded and previously-generated numbers.
Add PreviousRegistrationNumbers list to AccreditationApplicationModel for the regenerate audit trail.
Remember to update EprRegisterEnrolBackend.Test/.../FakeAccreditationApplicationPersistence.cs ShallowCopy - it currently does NOT copy RegistrationReference at all (pre-existing gap), so it must be added there along with PreviousRegistrationNumbers or tests will silently lose the value on every GetByIdAsync/GetByCaseManagementWorkItemIdAsync read through the fake.

title: Implement IRegulatoryNumberGenerator atomic increment + assembly service
description:
Generator service with Task<string> GenerateAsync(NumberType type, string agency, WasteProcessingType processingType, string orgId, MaterialType material, int year, CancellationToken ct). Uses Collection.FindOneAndUpdateAsync (Inc CurrentMax, ReturnDocument.After, IsUpsert=true) as a single atomic Mongo operation — no read-then-write — against the "R-{AgencyType}" or "A-{AgencyType}" composite key, then assembles the full number string (prefix+YY+AgencyType+OrgID(6)+Sequence(4)+Material). One shared method for both registration and accreditation, not two generators. YY = calendar year at generation time (working default per AC8's worked example; flagged pending product sign-off on AC1's calendar-vs-scheme-year open question before launch).

Depends on: RegulatoryNumberSequenceCounter model/collection task.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GenerateAsync produces a string matching ^[RA]\d{2}(ER|EX|NR|NX|SR|SX|WR|WX)\d{6}\d{4}(AL|FB|GO|GR|PA|PL|ST|WO)$ for every valid AgencyType/Material combination
- The atomic increment never produces a duplicate sequence value under concurrent callers against the same pool key (single Mongo FindOneAndUpdateAsync, no read-then-write)
notes:
DECIDED (2026-08-19, user confirmed, refined from first draft): caller supplies NATION, not Agency letter directly - mirrors the existing frontend pattern buildPaymentReference(nation, organisationId, isExporter) in epr-register-enrol-frontend (switch-on-nation + isExporter). Backend derives the Agency letter from Nation internally (England->E/EA, Scotland->S/SEPA, Wales->W/NRW, NorthernIreland->N/NIEA).

Nation enum values MUST match frontend's NATIONS constant exactly (src/server/common/helpers/nation-from-postcode.js in epr-register-enrol-frontend): England, Scotland, Wales, NorthernIreland (PascalCase, no spaces/underscores). Define as a C# enum with [JsonConverter(typeof(JsonStringEnumConverter))] (same pattern as MaterialType/ApplicationStatus in this codebase) so the wire format matches those exact strings with no naming-policy override needed.

Also caller-supplied: OrgId (int, 6-digit) - not derivable from AccreditationApplicationModel.OrganisationId (opaque string like "org-123"), no reliable real org lookup exists in this backend (see earlier finding on FakeOrganisationPersistence).

FINAL GenerateAsync signature: GenerateAsync(NumberType type, Nation nation, bool isExporter, int orgId, MaterialType material, GlassRecyclingProcess? glassRecyclingProcess, int year, CancellationToken ct). isExporter drives R/X. Material maps 1:1 (Steel=ST,Wood=WO,Aluminium=AL,Fibre=FB,Paper=PA,Plastic=PL) except Glass, which needs glassRecyclingProcess to pick GO(Other) vs GR(Remelt).

title: Create RegulatoryNumberSequenceCounter model + collection
description:
Mongo model + regulatoryNumberSequences collection for the 16 independent (R|A x AgencyType) sequence counters, following the existing MongoService<T> base class pattern used by AccreditationApplicationPersistence.cs.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Model RegulatoryNumberSequenceCounter has Id (string composite key, e.g. "R-ER"), CurrentMax (int), UpdatedAt (DateTime)
- regulatoryNumberSequences collection has a unique index on Id, defined via DefineIndexes following the existing MongoService<T> pattern
